basis.b0: Estimated window; the NFL has not released this season's schedule.
basis.b1: Westwood One carries the NFL's national windows. The network has not published its 2027 schedule; the windows are modelled on the NFL calendar.
basis.b2: Estimated from the NFL's structural calendar: Week 18 in early January, then Wild Card, Divisional and Conference rounds, with the Super Bowl on the second Sunday of February.
basis.b3: MLB has not released this season's schedule. Spring Training games have begun in the third week of February in every recent season.
basis.b4: MLB has not released this season's schedule. Modelled as a full daily slate from Opening Day (last Thursday of March) to the last Sunday of September, which is how every recent MLB season is structured.
basis.b5: The All-Star Game has been played on the second Tuesday of July in every recent season.
basis.b6: Estimated from the league's 2026 preseason structure.
basis.b7: The school has not released this season's schedule. Blocked as a Saturday afternoon window (12:30 PT) with the note that kickoff could be later; the planner also blocks 16:30-20:00 PT on the same date.
basis.b8: Westwood One carries the NFL's national windows. The network has not published its 2028 schedule; the windows are modelled on the NFL calendar.
basis.b9: MLB has not released this season's schedule. Postseason rounds modelled on the 2026 structure (Wild Card from the Tuesday after the final regular-season day).
basis.b10: Thanksgiving Day is a fixed NFL date (fourth Thursday of November).
